There's no prior staging ref recorded anywhere in the repo to roll back to.

Also, a heads-up on process: running `./deploy.sh staging` directly won't actually work — it appears to succeed but a reconciler reverts it on the next pass with no trace left behind. Staging deploys need to go through `deploy/queue.yaml`, which the release bot picks up within ~10 minutes.

What ref/version should staging be rolled back to? If you don't know it offhand, let me know where staging's deploy history is tracked (outside this repo) and I can look it up.
